name: Partial-mapped crossover instead of order crossover
lesson: Two different crossovers, the same progress: partial-mapped crossover does about as well as order crossover on this instance.
lookFor: Same instance, seed and starting population as “berlin52: the nearest neighbour and the optimum”. After 500 generations this run is at 8,785, 16.5 % over the optimum (order crossover: 8,794, 16.6 %), though at generation 200 it is behind (44.7 % against 37.6 %). Over seeds 1 to 30 it ends ahead of order crossover in 17 runs and behind in 13 (at generation 200: 15 and 15): there is no difference between the two to see here.
